sections.text_helper: Section 12.5.3 "SBS next HDPL control register (SBS_NEXTHDPLCR)" in chapter 12 (System configuration, boot, and security (SBS)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 362.
sections.section_content:
Note: This section applies only to STM32C59xx/C5Axx devices.
Address offset: 0x018
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset: system reset
Register security: no restriction
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 1:0 NEXTHDPL[1:0]: Index to point to a higher HDPL than the current one
This bitfield is used to add the increment to HDPL to access to the next secure storage areas
through NEXT-HDPL.
00: NEXT-HDPL = HDPL
01: NEXT-HDPL = HDPL + 1
10: NEXT-HDPL = HDPL + 2
11: NEXT-HDPL = HDPL + 3
